what_happened.line: The Board of Assessors denied four abatement applications, voting on each by address: Howard Street, Beale Street, Oak Ridge Road and Page Street.
The board granted or approved most of the remaining applications on staff recommendation, including Lancaster Avenue, two on Howard Street and others by number.
The Oak Ridge Road denial was recorded with the owner's refusal of an interior inspection noted.
Several grant votes, including 390 Howard Street and 652 Page Street, have no audible outcome in the recording.
Members agreed the mobile-home and unbuildable-land codes in the valuation tables should be reviewed after the next meeting.

why_it_matters: Abatements lower the assessed value of a single property, which changes that owner's tax bill. The denials and grants show how the board weighs inspections, sale prices and lot conditions.
The review of valuation table codes for mobile homes and unbuildable land could affect how those properties are assessed in later years.
